summary: Executed recruiter auth regression on public URL for backend + frontend. Verified signup/login/me APIs, token issuance, remember-me TTL behavior, protected route redirect, signup->dashboard redirect, remember-me storage persistence, and logout redirect.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested recruiter auth scope.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/server.py into smaller modules (currently very large).
critical_code_review_comments: No critical auth defect found in tested scope.
server.py remains a very large monolithic module, which increases regression risk and slows RCA for future auth/screener changes.
seed_data_creation: Created runtime test recruiters with unique emails (no persistent fixture files).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow validated end-to-end on public URL. Remember-me OFF stores token in sessionStorage; remember-me ON stores token in localStorage; protected /dashboard redirects unauthenticated users to /login; logout returns to auth page.
rca of the issue: No issue reproduced in requested recruiter auth scope.
